name: print-social-business-posts-white-with-orange-code-icons-and-big-headlines
title: White business pack with heavy black headlines, orange code-tag icons and cursor arrows
whatItIs: Ten square white posts with big bold black headlines ('Connect with Your Audience', 'Skyrocket Your Sales'), small photos of a team, orange circle icons with code brackets and arrows, cursor pointers, dot columns, orange stars and pill 'Join us' buttons.
whatItMeans: Straightforward and digital; web-style icons signal online marketing expertise.
techniques: Let a heavy headline fill half the post.
Use cursor and code icons as a digital signal.
Keep one small orange accent on white.

vocabulary.definition: A mouse-pointer symbol used as decoration.
